subject.title: Fix stale session routes for removed providers

question: Should OpenClaw ignore persisted session provider/model routes that are absent from current config/catalog and route those sessions to the configured default at runtime?
rationale: The patch looks mechanically correct, but the remaining choice changes upgrade-visible provider/auth routing for existing sessions and cannot be settled by CI alone.

options.title: Accept fallback-to-default semantics
options.body: Merge this runtime guard as the deleted-provider behavior and keep persistent cleanup as a separate follow-up.

options.title: Require fail-closed diagnostics
options.body: Ask for an explicit warning or fail-closed recovery path when catalog validation cannot prove the persisted route is still valid.

options.title: Expand scope to cleanup
options.body: Hold the PR until doctor, reset command, or migration behavior is included for stale persisted entries.

recommendation.title: Accept fallback-to-default semantics
recommendation.body: Merge this runtime guard as the deleted-provider behavior and keep persistent cleanup as a separate follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent session/gateway product work makes this the strongest available routing owner for the policy choice, with shared input likely useful from `vincentkoc` and `jalehman`.
